craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of sealing — utsāha as measure, course, denial, seal land in turn. Denial hammer: Not deluded — moment-by-moment grounded; relief without new machinery (rasa). Rejected: (a) softening Not → killed: denial opens the verse. (b) endless-awareness→infinite consciousness → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: NOT de-LUD-ed — THOUGH-called ERR-ing, ALL of-THEM … GROUND-ed IN-end-less-a-WARE-ness re-FLEC-tion.

lines: Not deluded — though called erring, all of them,
moment by moment, grounded in endless-awareness reflection.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na paraṃ tāstathā bhrāntāḥ sarvā api pratikṣaṇāt svasaṃvitsaṃjñakānantacidvimarśapratiṣṭhitāḥ

reads_against.argmap: Are they deluded? → Not deluded: moment-by-moment grounded in self-awareness-reflection.
c1_essence: Secondaries measured against chiefs — king's man, brahmin's; other chiefs, other unities — king's horse, man (vv19-20).
Course told, delusion denied, seal spoken: Māyā-knower-resting intellects drive transaction, moment-grounded in self-awareness; told, proved, unrefuted, useful, full apparatus besides (vv21-23).
